sources.snippet: Checkpoint Engine Checkpoint-engine is a simple middleware to update model weights in LLM inference engines -- a critical step in reinforcement learning. We provide an efficient and lightweight implementation for inplace weight update: updating our Kimi-K2 model (1 Trillion parameters) across thousands of GPUs takes about 20s.
